title: docs: regenerate APIDOCS.md
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec changes after a successful production deploy.

gist.headline: The map got redrawn
gist.blurb: The API field guide has been regenerated from the production OpenAPI spec. Fewer mystery endpoints, more accurately labeled flowers.
gist.summary: Regenerated APIDOCS.md from the current production OpenAPI specification, adding and updating 1,386 lines of API reference material.
gist.impact: Developers get documentation that more closely matches the endpoints, parameters, and responses currently deployed in production.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy API field guide being updated from a glowing terminal: Polli acts as a tiny librarian with reading glasses, carefully stamping fresh endpoint pages while code-plants grow from the desk. A CRT monitor robot can hold an oversized reference sheet covered in simple pixel API symbols, with flowers and vines representing newly documented routes.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny librarian glasses and updating a large API field guide beside a glowing retro terminal. A cheerful CRT monitor robot holds a fresh reference page with simple pixel text 'API DOCS', while code-plants and small flowers sprout around the desk; lime green (#ecf874) is prominent among warm cream, mint, and lavender pastels. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
